en: Colorized vintage view of a large European town square with historic multi-story buildings surrounding an open plaza. In the center stands an ornate monument with several statues and a staircase, surrounded by people and market stalls shaded by white umbrellas. A tram is visible on the right. Printed at the top is the caption 'Graz, Hauptplatz', and there is handwritten text with a date at the bottom margin.
